summary: The always-listening damage receiver, so a target needs one component whatever hit it.
overview: Attach alongside Health, or anything implementing IDamageable. Melee hitboxes, hitscan shots and projectiles all funnel into ReceiveHit, so a target understands ONE hit shape regardless of what attacked it. That is the whole reason the combat core splits this way.
useCases: A character that can be hit by any attack type.
Weak points that take extra damage, via the multiplier.
Reacting to being hit — flash, sound, stagger — without knowing the attacker.

params.tuning: This is how you build weak points and armour: 2 on a head collider, 0.5 on a plated back. Several hurtboxes on one character each with its own multiplier is the intended setup.

gotchas.title: It receives hits, it does not store health
gotchas.body: Without a Health or other IDamageable alongside, hits are received and go nowhere.

gotchas.title: Knockback only applies if the target implements IKnockbackReceiver
gotchas.body: That is optional by design, so a static target simply ignores the knockback part of a hit.
